reason: The residency prototype meets every required criterion except the aspirational time target: pan loading fell to 0/120 (was 18/120; reference 5/120) and zoom held at 0/24, while the three structural observations are true and every previously passing gate check still passes. Time readiness is 16/18, equal to the #66 no-lookahead baseline and above the retired precursor's 12/18; the brief defers resident time windows to #67, so time is recorded as the remaining gap, not a regression of this change.

profile.note: A window shifted 120 px shares 10678 of 11625 nodes with the previous window, so the memo can avoid almost all per-node work.

failing_check: weather remains current during every interaction input

reference.artifact: viewport-continuous-summary.json (retired precursor) and viewport-double-buffer-summary.json (#66 no lookahead)

endpoint: QQuickWindow.afterRendering render-callback proxy; not presentation FPS, input-to-present or scanout

change.reuse_layer: NodeSampleMemo: byte-bounded (16 MiB declared ceiling) LRU of the exact float32 endpoint pair and provenance per (source set, time window, node), plus per-node land decisions per shoreline quality. stage_wind prefills cached endpoints and only samples remaining nodes; stage_field consults the land memo. Only finite pairs are stored, so holes and mask semantics are unchanged.
change.recentring_layer: GribViewportModel watches the same REFILL_VIEW_FACTOR guard the scheduler prefers. While a ready field is presented and the guard is no longer covered, it queues exactly one deterministic re-centred window: one field lattice ahead along the camera's direction of motion, through the existing two-slot pipeline and generation keys. A stationary camera re-centres nothing.
change.semantics: The memo is a pure function of the same inputs; a new stage_wind test asserts a memoized shifted window is bit-identical to cold staging, and a land-memo test asserts a stored False is a hit. The application path passes no memo and is byte-identical.

limits: Time readiness is not met: 16/18 vs the aspirational 12/18; resident time windows are #67
continuous_weather (all 162 ready) stays red as the brief expects
No direct hardware-upload or presentation-FPS measurement
The time-change cancellation policy is unchanged; a 30 Hz time sweep still outruns preparation
The 16 MiB memo ceiling and entry-byte estimate are declared, not measured optima
next_step: #67 owns resident time windows: keep the spatial result, add deterministic next-event temporal residency, then rerun one native attempt. Do not extend this prototype's scope.
